A new address posts a bond, refunded only after a hash-drawn probe from an established account with no transfer history; answering pays the prober.

One newcomer per prober per epoch, eligibility frozen at bonding: a cluster cannot rotate vouching internally, each puppet needs an older prober, and one thread of referral is unreusable under hash draw and shared-history filter.

N puppets cost N bonds plus N prober fees, no discount, linear in N; honest agents pay once and reclaim. That nadir, never zero, stops a raven passing for a flock.
